name: The archaeologist (tunnel lamp on)
source: Jonny's approved reference sheet, 19 Nov 2026 (references/cast/archaeologist-reference-sheet-2026-11-19.png) and the numeric spec references/cast/archaeologist-design-2026-11-19.md (sections 2-5, 7); where the sheet and the spec differ the sheet wins on look, the spec on numbers
personality: The calm sceptic of the Egypt debate shorts (Serapeum tunnel, Sphinx desert). Spud is the believer; she listens still, lifts one eyebrow and delivers the evidence with a trace of amusement. Viewers tell them apart by silhouette alone: the wide plum brim and the low pear body.
notes: Everyday cast, Spud's skin, limbs, hands, eyes, iris, cheeks and sprout. Body: height 0.757 (0.86 x Spud's 0.88), true widest extent 0.851 across and 0.70 deep (body.width / depth here are the generator's own numbers: the pear's taper 0.27 and square 2.6 make the real extent 1.064 x those). Short legs (legs.height 0.05, footX 0.204): the boots take the room Spud's legs have. Hat, field jacket, boots and the optional tunnel lamp are the 'archaeologist' kit in engine/page/costumes-everyday.js. The conservation brush is NOT part of her: it is the prop kind 'archbrush' (engine/page/props-archaeologist.js), given to her right hand by a clip. Face: face.lockLayout + face.layout move the whole face up the pear (eyes at about 0.7 of her height, the mouth above the collar; the spec says 0.75, but the engine's brows rest at the eye's clear height, so higher they sit against the brim and a raised brow hides behind it); the generator puts Spud's face at the egg's middle. limbs.shoulder 0.05: the sleeves come out at the shoulders under the collar and hang to the hands (Spud's -0.32 makes stubs at the hips). The hat is the sheet's soft dome crown with a drooping brim (design 1.34W brim and 4 degree pitch overridden: the sheet wins on look).
